summary: This project is created by using the programming language of scratch. This games main objective and goal is to create any rocket your heart desires by using three main parts (Roof, Base, Engine). Lastly there is a cost for the parts and your budget is ten thousand dollars. This teaches you to think ahead so you can create the ship your heart desires while managing your budget.
details: This project is mainly about creating your rocket ship with three parts called the roof, base and engine while maintaining your budget of ten thousand dollars.
